name: update_unknown
description: Append one immutable full-state revision and mutation evidence. The unknown retains its original scope; the mutation Evidence subject is the active binary analysis target, or null without one, and can differ from that scope. Requires exact expected_revision; stale concurrent writers fail instead of overwriting newer analysis.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

contradicting_evidence_ids.description: Ordered Evidence identifiers for the contradicting observations.

expected_revision.description: Expected revision used to reject stale or mismatched input.

supporting_evidence_ids.description: Ordered Evidence identifiers for the supporting observations.
